title: Arrow comparisons for fixed affine étale pullbacks
statement: Let f:T→S be affine, p:L→T and r:L→S with p followed by f equal to r. Let vS and vT be functors from the full affine étale categories over S and T to that over L, with underlying natural transformations qS and qT whose squares are pullbacks over r and p. Fix A, a finite family B_a over S, and arrows g_a:vS(B_a)→vS(A). Suppose scheme morphisms ψj_a:B_a ×_S T→A respect the structure maps and, on further pullback to L, equal the composite of the inverse qS-pullback comparison, g_a and qS at A. There are arrows fi_a between the canonical affine étale pullbacks over T, and isomorphisms from their vT-images to the vS-images, such that vT(fi_a) followed by the target comparison equals the source comparison followed by g_a.

proof.text: Define fi by pullback.lift of ψj and the second projection and lift it through Over.homMk and ObjectProperty.homMk. Paste the qT-square with the canonical base-change square and rewrite p followed by f as r. Both this pasted square and the qS-square are pullbacks over r; composing their isoPullback isomorphisms yields scheme isomorphisms over L, hence full affine étale isomorphisms. To prove the arrow equality apply the two faithful forgetful layers and hom_ext for the qS target square. The first projection equality follows from qT naturality, the lift first-projection formula, and the assumed descent equality, using pullback.hom_ext to identify the canonical map. The second projection equality follows because every arrow is over L. This includes the empty family and f an identity.

theorem affineEtale_pullback_arrow_comparison
    {S T L : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ S) [IsAffineHom f]
    (p : L ⟶ T) (r : L ⟶ S) (hr : p ≫ f = r)
    (vS : S.FullAffineEtale ⥤ L.FullAffineEtale)
    (vT : T.FullAffineEtale ⥤ L.FullAffineEtale)
    (qS : vS ⋙ fullAffineEtaleInclusion L ⋙ Etale.forget L ⋙ Over.forget L ⟶
      fullAffineEtaleInclusion S ⋙ Etale.forget S ⋙ Over.forget S)
    (qT : vT ⋙ fullAffineEtaleInclusion L ⋙ Etale.forget L ⋙ Over.forget L ⟶
      fullAffineEtaleInclusion T ⋙ Etale.forget T ⋙ Over.forget T)
    (hS : ∀ A : S.FullAffineEtale,
      IsPullback (qS.app A) (vS.obj A).obj.hom A.obj.hom r)
    (hT : ∀ A : T.FullAffineEtale,
      IsPullback (qT.app A) (vT.obj A).obj.hom A.obj.hom p)
    (n : ℕ) (A : S.FullAffineEtale) (B : Fin n → S.FullAffineEtale)
    (g : ∀ a, vS.obj (B a) ⟶ vS.obj A)
    (ψj : ∀ a, pullback (B a).obj.hom f ⟶ A.obj.left)
    (hψj : ∀ a, ψj a ≫ A.obj.hom = pullback.fst (B a).obj.hom f ≫ (B a).obj.hom)
    (hdesc : ∀ a,
      pullback.map (B a).obj.hom r (B a).obj.hom f
        (𝟙 _) p (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simpa using hr.symm) ≫ ψj a =
        (hS (B a)).isoPullback.inv ≫ (g a).hom.left ≫ qS.app A) :
    ∃ (fi : ∀ a, (affineEtaleBaseChange f).obj (B a) ⟶
        (affineEtaleBaseChange f).obj A)
      (t : vT.obj ((affineEtaleBaseChange f).obj A) ≅ vS.obj A)
      (s : ∀ a, vT.obj ((affineEtaleBaseChange f).obj (B a)) ≅ vS.obj (B a)),
      ∀ a, vT.map (fi a) ≫ t.hom = (s a).hom ≫ g a
